name: Tikha mitha mix
ingredients_raw: EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (REFINED PALMOLEIN OIL), BENGAL GRAM FLOUR (BESAN) (18%), CORN FLAKES (17%), GREEN PEAS (5%). CHANA DAL (5%), SUGAR (4.5%), REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA). WHOLE GREEN MOONG (2.5%), EDIBLE COMMON SALT (BLACK SALT), SESAME SEEDS, SPICES & CONDIMENTS (TURMERIC, CLOVE, CINNAMON, STAR ANISE, CORIANDER SEEDS, FENNEL, RED CHILLI (0.6%), DRY MANGO POWDER, ASAFOETIDA) AND RAISING AGENT (INS 500(11))
